description: Alberta Geological Survey describes bathymetry for Glenmore Reservoir in three complementary representations: an Arc ASCII elevation grid, line contours and a boundary polygon. Available historical bathymetric information was compiled and hard-copy maps were digitised where necessary. The source says the data were checked against newer Shuttle Radar Topography Mission and Indian Remote Sensing imagery and corrected where needed; this is a source-reported processing step, with no independently established accuracy. The three package descriptions explicitly identify the same reservoir and those representations. They are grouped as one reservoir geometry dataset, not three independent resources. The grid has a ZIP link labelled ASCII GRID. The contour and boundary descriptions specify shapefiles, but their returned resource lists contain only HTML/XML metadata links. The source date fields say 2008; individual survey dates, vertical datum, grid spacing and contour interval are unstated. This geometry directly describes an engineered water-storage asset. It does not establish storage capacity, operating rules, water-supply purpose or present reservoir condition. Open Government Licence - Alberta and unrestricted access are stated, while the isopen flag is false. Costs and actual payload access remain unknown. No grid, shapefile, archive or linked document body was fetched. Spatial coverage is the named reservoir in Alberta. Specific simulation uses are not stated in the source metadata.
